Information on crate labels
This article is for families

crate labels for smooth animal travel

When you prepare a crate for Aurelia Skyways, clear labels make the trip easier for everyone. They help the Companion Animal Travel Desk match the crate with the right traveler, and they also help the cabin team keep a steady record while the animal is moving through the journey. A neat label is one of the simplest ways to avoid confusion at the counter and on arrival.

Use a label that is easy to read and place it where staff can see it without turning the crate around. The traveler name should match the booking exactly, and the contact details should stay current. If the animal has special handling notes, add them in a simple way and keep the wording clear. A label should stay attached through check-in, loading, and arrival pickup, even when the crate is handled more than once.

<<FACT F091>> Keep any extra notes brief so the passenger coordinator can review them quickly. If a change happens after you arrive, tell the desk right away so the ledger can be updated. That way, the record stays consistent and the animal's travel plan stays on track.

For boarding, remember that the crate needs the right form on file. <<FACT F087>> Bring the form with you if you were asked to carry a copy, and keep it with the rest of the travel papers. Small details like this save time and reduce stress at the counter.

When your animal reaches the destination, the pickup process is watched by <<FACT F101>>. If someone else will collect the crate, make sure the name on the label and the pickup details both match the record. That helps the handoff stay calm and orderly.

If you need more help with crate labels or any related travel step, please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
